fuentes.entradilla: Saurav Das was due to give talks at UK universities on protest movement but says ‘coward government’ prevented him flying A leader of India’s youth-led Cockroach movement has said he was prevented from leaving Delhi to fly to the UK to give talks on the viral group’s protests. Saurav Das, 27, has been at the forefront of the Cockroach Janta party (CJP), which has amassed millions of social media followers since its launch in May.
